title: Modulo-eight nonvanishing at every odd Lemire endpoint
statement: For every integer ell at least one, the number I_(2ell+1)(1) of monic irreducible binary polynomials of degree 2ell+1 congruent to 1 modulo x^(ell+1) is not divisible by eight.

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; exact odd-endpoint residues and Carlitz two-adic precision re-aim

notes: The exact native report finds nonzero residues modulo eight in every odd endpoint from degree 3 through degree 51, with maximum observed two-adic valuation two. Those 25 rows are stopping diagnostics only and do not establish the quantified statement. The proved identity N_(2ell+1)(1)=1+(2ell+1)I_(2ell+1)(1) means this fact would settle every odd Lemire endpoint. Deuring-Shafarevich gives two-rank zero for the associated one-branch-point Carlitz cover but does not provide the point-count precision modulo 2^(ell+3) required to prove the residue. Exact primitive-character Newton polygons have minimum slopes 1/4 from conductor level four and 1/8 from level eight, so low positive slopes require cancellation across the complete Galois and conductor aggregate rather than a near-half characterwise cutoff. No Autogenesis operation is registered because the bounded exact checkers cannot establish universal nonvanishing.
